title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
summary: Introducing GPT‑6 Cyber, OpenAI’s cybersecurity model for finding exploitable vulnerabilities and developing fixes, trained to stay within authorized scope.
title_es: OpenAI presenta GPT-6 Cyber para agentes de ciberseguridad
bajada: OpenAI lanzó GPT-6 Cyber, un modelo especializado en encontrar vulnerabilidades explotables y desarrollar soluciones de seguridad. El modelo está entrenado para mantenerse dentro del alcance autorizado, marcando un avance en la automatización de tareas de ciberseguridad.
bajada_en: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Cyber, a specialized model for finding exploitable vulnerabilities and developing security fixes. The model is trained to stay within authorized scope, marking an advance in automating cybersecurity tasks.

title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
summary: Text "Gemini Introducing Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash" surroudned by images of a beehive, animals in conversation, a squid, and a woman walking down a street
title_es: Google presenta Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash más rápido y económico
bajada: Google lanzó Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, una versión optimizada de su modelo multimodal con mejor rendimiento y costos reducidos. Soporta clips más largos, mejorando la capacidad para procesar contenido visual y de audio extendido.
bajada_en: Google launched Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, an optimized version of its multimodal model with improved performance and reduced costs. It supports longer clips, enhancing the ability to process extended visual and audio content.

title: Vera Delivers the Best of Both Worlds: Highest Throughput and Fastest Agents
summary: AI agents do more than generate answers. They search for information, query databases, write and test code and take action.  Each of those steps relies on a CPU, with agents moving between GPU reasoning and CPU execution throughout a task.  As businesses put more agents to work, AI factories need CPUs that can execute those […]
title_es: NVIDIA presenta Vera para agentes de IA de alto rendimiento
bajada: NVIDIA anunció Vera, una solución que optimiza el equilibrio entre throughput y latencia en agentes de IA. La plataforma mejora la ejecución en CPU de tareas complejas que requieren alternancia entre razonamiento en GPU y ejecución en CPU.
bajada_en: NVIDIA announced Vera, a solution that optimizes the balance between throughput and latency in AI agents. The platform improves CPU execution for complex tasks requiring switching between GPU reasoning and CPU execution.

title: Perplexity launches its own take on AI agents for work
summary: Perplexity is taking on OpenAI and Anthropic with its own work-focused AI agents. The startup's new always-on "Teammates" can take on multiple roles within a workspace, while pulling existing projects, skills, and memory from the Perplexity tools you already use. Teammates integrate with Perplexity Computer, an AI system that can deploy agents on your device […]
title_es: Perplexity lanza Teammates, agentes de IA para el trabajo
bajada: Perplexity presentó Teammates, agentes de IA siempre activos que pueden asumir múltiples roles en espacios de trabajo. Los agentes se integran con Perplexity Computer y acceden a proyectos, habilidades y memoria existentes dentro del ecosistema.
bajada_en: Perplexity unveiled Teammates, always-on AI agents that can assume multiple roles within workspaces. The agents integrate with Perplexity Computer and access existing projects, skills, and memory within the ecosystem.

title: Claude AI can plug directly into your bank account
summary: Anthropic has a new pitch for managing your personal finances: let Claude do it instead, with a new Personal Finance feature that connects it to your bank and card accounts via the Plaid bank bridging platform. You can ask the chatbot "where did my money go this month," for example, and it'll create an overview […]
title_es: Claude puede conectarse directamente a tu cuenta bancaria
bajada: Anthropic integró a Claude con Plaid para permitir gestión de finanzas personales mediante IA. Los usuarios pueden hacer preguntas sobre sus gastos y Claude analiza sus cuentas bancarias para proporcionar resumen de movimientos.
bajada_en: Anthropic integrated Claude with Plaid to enable personal finance management through AI. Users can ask questions about their spending and Claude analyzes their bank accounts to provide transaction summaries.

title: New NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Open Models for Interactive World Simulation
title_es: NVIDIA Cosmos 3: modelos abiertos para simulación interactiva
bajada: NVIDIA lanzó nuevos modelos abiertos de Cosmos 3 para simulación interactiva del mundo. Estos modelos permiten a desarrolladores crear y simular escenarios complejos con IA generativa.
bajada_en: NVIDIA released new open Cosmos 3 models for interactive world simulation. These models enable developers to create and simulate complex scenarios with generative AI.

title: OpenAI president Greg Brockman says company could be IPO ready in 2027
summary: Speaking at a Wall Street Journal tech conference on Wednesday, the executive touted how the company had been gaining ground in the enterprise market, where rival Anthropic had already successfully made inroads.
title_es: OpenAI podría estar lista para IPO en 2027, según ejecutivo
bajada: Greg Brockman, presidente de OpenAI, indicó que la compañía podría estar lista para salida a bolsa en 2027. Brockman destacó el crecimiento en el mercado empresarial, competiendo con Anthropic en ese segmento.
bajada_en: OpenAI president Greg Brockman indicated the company could be IPO-ready in 2027. Brockman highlighted growth in the enterprise market, competing with Anthropic in that segment.

title: Tencent Launches Hy4, One of the Leading Open-Source AI Models
title_es: Tencent lanza Hy4, modelo de IA de código abierto líder
bajada: Tencent presentó Hy4, un modelo de IA de código abierto que se posiciona entre los líderes globales. El modelo está disponible para la comunidad de desarrolladores con licencia abierta.
bajada_en: Tencent unveiled Hy4, an open-source AI model positioned among global leaders. The model is available to the developer community under an open license.

title: Cyera’s $800 Million Haul Shows Cyber Fever Hasn’t Broken
summary: Last week my colleagues Jemima and Validascoopedthat Cyera, a five-year-old cloud security startup, was mulling a new fundraise at an eye-popping $20 billion valuation, up from $12 billion in June.Since then, those talks have gotten more serious, I’ve learned. Cyera is indeed planning to raise around $800 million in a round led by Cyberstarts, which wrote the startup’s first seed check in 2021, according to two people with knowledge of the deal.
title_es: Cyera recauda $800M a valoración de $20 mil millones
bajada: Cyera, startup de ciberseguridad en la nube, está recaudando $800 millones en una ronda liderada por Cyberstarts. La valoración alcanza $20 mil millones, reflejando demanda sostenida por soluciones de seguridad en IA.
bajada_en: Cyera, a cloud security startup, is raising $800 million in a round led by Cyberstarts. The valuation reaches $20 billion, reflecting sustained demand for AI security solutions.

title: Airbnb says it’s launching an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027
summary: Airbnb says its upcoming AI agent will help travelers plan trips, compare options, manage bookings, and get assistance throughout their stay.
title_es: Airbnb planea lanzar agente de IA de viajes en 2027
bajada: Airbnb anunció que lanzará un agente de IA en la primera mitad de 2027 para planificar viajes, comparar opciones y gestionar reservas. La herramienta asistirá a viajeros a lo largo de toda su experiencia de booking.
bajada_en: Airbnb announced it will launch an AI agent in the first half of 2027 to plan trips, compare options, and manage bookings. The tool will assist travelers throughout their entire booking experience.

title: OpenAI is stepping back from NDAs for data center projects
summary: Following this week's midterms where voters resoundingly voiced their opposition to data center expansion, OpenAI today announced new commitments to communities where it is working on data center projects, including that it won't use non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) with public officials. Many data center projects have come under scrutiny for relying on NDAs to hide discussions […]
title_es: OpenAI se retracta de NDAs en proyectos de centros de datos
bajada: OpenAI anunció que no usará acuerdos de confidencialidad (NDAs) con funcionarios públicos en sus proyectos de centros de datos. La decisión responde a creciente escrutinio público sobre expansión de infraestructura de IA.
bajada_en: OpenAI announced it won't use non-disclosure agreements with public officials for its data center projects. The decision responds to growing public scrutiny over AI infrastructure expansion.

title: A Closer Look at Phonon TTS. Launching High-Quality On-Device Speech That Tops the Benchmarks.
title_es: Phonon TTS: síntesis de voz de alto rendimiento en dispositivos
bajada: Phonon lanzó un modelo de TTS de alta calidad optimizado para ejecutarse localmente en dispositivos. El modelo supera benchmarks existentes en calidad de síntesis de voz sin requerir conexión a servidores.
bajada_en: Phonon launched a high-quality TTS model optimized to run locally on devices. The model outperforms existing benchmarks in speech synthesis quality without requiring server connectivity.

title: Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar
summary: Meta's AI agent can now take calls as a customizable animated avatar, ahead of the launch of a Tamagotchi-like wearable designed to bring Muse to life.
title_es: Meta permite videollamadas con avatares de IA personalizados
bajada: Meta habilitó videollamadas con avatares animados personalizados de su agente Muse para usuarios en EE.UU. La funcionalidad anticipa el lanzamiento de un wearable estilo Tamagotchi dedicado a Muse.
bajada_en: Meta enabled video calls with customizable animated avatars of its Muse AI agent for US users. The feature previews the upcoming launch of a Tamagotchi-like wearable dedicated to Muse.

title: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents
summary: Turning a simulation idea into a working application means assembling assets, connecting physics and rendering, and checking that the scene behaves as intended. Developers are combining frontier AI models with NVIDIA Omniverse libraries to help carry out that work — building applications for exploring scenarios, investigating failures and improving designs. Developers direct AI agents through […]
title_es: Desarrolladores usan agentes de IA para crear simulaciones con Omniverse
bajada: Desarrolladores combinan modelos de IA frontier con librerías de NVIDIA Omniverse para construir aplicaciones de simulación. Los agentes de IA automatizan tareas de ensamblaje de assets, conexión de física y validación de escenas.
bajada_en: Developers combine frontier AI models with NVIDIA Omniverse libraries to build simulation applications. AI agents automate asset assembly, physics connection, and scene validation tasks.

title: Merge builds product and business tools with OpenAI technology
summary: Merge uses GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT, and Codex to review product code and support marketing. Its teams also use AI to plan executive dinners and prepare sales updates.
title_es: Merge construye herramientas de producto con tecnología OpenAI
bajada: Merge utiliza GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT y Codex para revisar código de productos y soportar marketing. El caso muestra cómo empresas integran múltiples modelos de OpenAI en flujos de trabajo empresariales complejos.
bajada_en: Merge uses GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT, and Codex to review product code and support marketing. The case shows how companies integrate multiple OpenAI models into complex enterprise workflows.
